public_rationale: Contemporary Ars reporting repeats Marcus's claim, so there is direct published support. But the underlying records identify seven qualifying lawsuits. Counting the separate Adams estate suit would require evidence that Adams herself used ChatGPT; the court record identifies her son Soelberg as the user. The reported total therefore remains unverified under Marcus's actual wording. An incomplete inventory also cannot establish that fewer than eight existed, so contradiction is not justified.
limitations: The records establish allegations and filings, not that ChatGPT caused the deaths.
Later court records are used only to reconstruct earlier filings; later lawsuits do not count.
No comprehensive docket search establishes an upper bound on qualifying cases.
